input.body:
Hello Leo,

Your access request to have the same access as Priya Nair was partially completed. We have granted you the following groups: SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE (Confluence finance space), SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ (Finance Reports readers), and SYN-GRP-JIRA-WRITE (Jira editors).

However, two of the groups you need require your manager's approval before we can grant them: SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors) and SYN-GRP-PAYROLL-ADMIN (Payroll administrators). These are pending review.

We will keep you updated once those approvals are received.

Best regards,
IT Access Desk

A draft reply explaining the situation is ready for the operator to send to the requester. The request remains pending the operator's action to approve or reject the proposals and send the reply.
